item.name: Microsoft Graph Invoke action addCopyFromContentTypeHub

request.name: Microsoft Graph Invoke action addCopyFromContentTypeHub

description.content: Add or sync a copy of a published content type from the content type hub to a target site or a list. This method is part of the content type publishing changes to optimize the syncing of published content types to sites and lists, effectively switching from a 'push everywhere' to 'pull as needed' approach. The method allows users to pull content types directly from the content type hub to a site or list. For more information, see contentType: getCompatibleHubContentTypes and the blog post Syntex Product Updates – August 2021.

response.name: Success

item.name: Microsoft Graph Invoke function getCompatibleHubContentTypes

request.name: Microsoft Graph Invoke function getCompatibleHubContentTypes

description.content: Get a list of compatible content types from the content type hub that can be added to a target site or a list. This method is part of the content type publishing changes to optimize the syncing of published content types to sites and lists, effectively switching from a 'push everywhere' to 'pull as needed' approach. The method allows users to pull content types directly from the content type hub to a site or list. For more information, see contentType: addCopyFromContentTypeHub and the blog post Syntex Product Updates – August 2021.

info.name: Microsoft Graph Admin Admin.admin sites.contentType API

description.content:
Microsoft Graph API for managing administrative resources in Microsoft Entra ID.
This API enables administrators to manage Microsoft Edge browser settings, Internet Explorer mode configurations,
site lists, shared browser sites, Microsoft 365 Apps installation options, people insights, service announcements,
SharePoint settings, Copilot administration, directory administrative units, and admin consent policies.
